review_text: We had a disappointing experience using Uber in Mangalore. The main issue was the lack of proper communication and transparency between the app, the drivers, and the passengers. The pickup and drop-off locations shown to us in the app were sometimes different from what was being shown to the drivers, which caused confusion, especially at the time of drop-off. There was also a lack of clear fare transparency, as the fare shown in the app did not always match what was being expected or negotiated by the driver. Passengers should be able to know exactly what they are expected to pay, without having to negotiate or deal with unexpected extra charges. Uber should provide clear and consistent information about the fare and pickup/drop-off locations to both passengers and drivers to avoid such misunderstandings.

review_text: I booked an Uber Auto in the morning to go to work. The app initially showed the driver would arrive in 1-2 minutes, but the time kept increasing repeatedly. When I tried calling the number provided in the app, it said it was an invalid number, and my text messages got no reply. After some time, the app showed that he had arrived. Since I was already running late for work, I was in a rush. The driver called me, and I told him I was standing right in front of Jubilee Mission Hospital. When he finally came and picked me up, I mentioned that he was quite late and we should get going. Instead of focusing on the ride, he started arguing that I should have specifically mentioned 'bus stop' instead of just saying Jubilee Mission front. I explained that both sides of the road have bus stops and I was waiting on the correct side going toward Paravattani. However, he kept scolding and arguing with me about this repeatedly inside the auto. Even when I asked him to drop the topic and just move on, he continued to be very rude. Finally, when I asked if I should just get out, he told me to get down, and I had to leave the vehicle. Because of this incident, I got very late for work and was forced to catch another bus. This was a deeply hurtful and distressing experience for me. How can Uber allow such drivers to work on the platform? This severely damages Uber's reputation and name. Please take strict action against this driver.
